notes.title: Demo Update 0.6
notes.content:
After a couple of months of work the update for the Demo is ready.

The original Demo lacked in a lot of aspects but it was successful at starting to bring in feedback.

This update addressees that feedback and expands on the game's features.

The card fight in the original version lacked and couldn't really be called a card fight. The complete system and UI of it has been reworked and now should create some more interesting experiences i hope.

There's been a lot of polishes in the way the ship controller works, making it easier to control the fleet, with some visual improvements to it.

A few new ships have been added to slowly start assembling a "bit of everything". At the moment the game contains a small variability is ships from missile carriers to huge fuel carrying tankers to small agile fighter ships. To provide a challenge to the player and to also give them options on the battle field.

Along with a lot more small changes that hopefully elevates the experience.
